blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — It was “general knowledge” that alleged “kickbacks” given to various proponents, including senators, are given by contractors of government infrastructure projects. This was according to NBI investigative agent III Ivan Bernard Samson, who was the prosecution’s first witness before the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division on Tuesday during the first day of the bail hearing of Sen. Jinggoy Estrada. “For all of the witnesses in all flood control cases, based on our investigation, it’s a general knowledge that all of the funds, all of the kickback money that are given to proponents are payments coming from the contractor,” he said.
